title: Fail-open past an unknown algorithm (registered A3.6.2 item 3 companion)
scenario: The broken verifier treats an unknown algorithm as passed and accepts its opaque signature.

mutations.detail: choice (i): both frames and the manifest carry one unknown alg, signatures opaque and non-verifying

choices: The model gives each slot its own alg; V1 has one common alg (rows 6.2, 6.3). (i) Same unknown alg in both slots -> UNVERIFIABLE / ALG_UNKNOWN (HY-b2-H). (ii) Slots disagree -> INVALID / RECEIPT_COMMON_MISMATCH (HY-e1-C). Neither reproduces the trace's mixed-slot state exactly.

needs: Frames re-signed or with opaque signatures: re-build a_sig (no service key needed for non-verifying signatures).

subcases.title: Choice (i): one alg, unknown to the installation
subcases.construction: choice (i): conformance HY-b2-H construction (hybrid installation; classical-id frames and manifest, non-verifying rule-O signatures)
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)

subcases.title: Choice (ii): the slots' alg values disagree
subcases.construction: choice (ii): conformance HY-e1-C construction (kms frame pair id, gpg frame classical id; classical installation)
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
